Create a header or footer object for a section

Source: R/rtfreport.R
rtf_header.Rd

rtf_header() and rtf_footer() create structured header/footer objects that can be passed to rtf_section().

Usage

rtf_header(
  rows,
  border = NULL,
  width_twips = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  row_height_twips = NULL,
  font_size_half_points = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  markup = NULL,
  cell_padding_left_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_right_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_top_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_bottom_twips = NULL,
  drop_empty_rows = FALSE,
  color = NULL
)

rtf_footer(
  rows,
  border = rtf_border(top = TRUE),
  width_twips = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  row_height_twips = NULL,
  font_size_half_points = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  markup = NULL,
  cell_padding_left_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_right_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_top_twips = NULL,
  cell_padding_bottom_twips = NULL,
  drop_empty_rows = FALSE,
  color = NULL
)

Arguments

rows

The header (or footer) content, row by row: a single named character vector for one row, or a list of them for several rows. Within a row, the name of each element chooses its column:

l

left-aligned text

c

centred text

r

right-aligned text

e.g. c(l = "Protocol XYZ-001", r = "Page {AUTO_PAGE}"). A row may also be a list, list(columns = c(l = , c = , r = ), row_height_twips = 400L, color = "#C00000", border = rtf_border(bottom = TRUE), bold = TRUE), whose row_height_twips is that row's height (over the band's row_height_twips), color its text colour (over the band's color), border its own rtf_border() (see border), and bold, italic and underline (each TRUE or FALSE, default FALSE) the emphasis of every cell of the row, the words a title row uses (rtf_titles()). Tokens and ^{} / _{} markup work inside them. A value that is not one TRUE / FALSE is an error naming the row. Cell text may contain page-number tokens that the renderer substitutes: {AUTO_PAGE} (the current page, updated live by the viewer), {AUTO_TOTAL_PAGES} (the document total), and {PAGE} / {TOTAL_PAGES} (static numbers baked in at render time). A table paginated on a column (as_rtftables(page_by = )) gives each page its value of that column, written {<column name>} ({PARAM}): the band then shows the page's value, and is written for each page. See Page values in rtf_tables(). The run tokens ({PROGRAM}, {DATETIME}), the {BOOK_PAGE} slot and tokens of one's own (rtf_document()(tokens = )) are filled too (rtf_text_tokens() lists them); a token's value is written as it is, and an unknown token is printed as written. {{ and }} print a literal { and } (as in a column header), so "{{PAGE}}" prints {PAGE} and fills nothing. With markup = "script", the braces of ^{...} / _{...} are the markup's own: ^{STUDY} raises the word STUDY. To raise a token's value, write the token inside the braces, ^{{STUDY}}, or after a character, ^{n={STUDY}}.

border

An rtf_border() for the band as a whole, read as a table zone's is: top above the first row, bottom below the last row, inside_h between rows, left / right on the outer edges of every row, inside_v between the cells of a row (all is the four outer edges). The rows are the ones written, after drop_empty_rows. A row given as a list may carry its own border =, merged side by side over the band's, so the sides it sets win; it applies to that row's outer edges and its inside_v. A line both of two rows draw between them is drawn once, as the upper row's bottom. NULL = no border (default for the header); rtf_border(top = TRUE), a rule above the band, is the footer's default.

width_twips

Integer. Table width in twips. NULL (default) uses the full writable width (page width minus margins); so does 0, as rtftable(table_width_twips = 0) does, since a band of no width cannot be read (width, when given, then sets the width). A value that is not one non-negative integer is an error.

width

Band width in the shared vocabulary: "page" (the writable width, the default), a fraction in (0, 1] of it, or twips (a whole number above 1; 1.5 or Inf is an error). width_twips is the older absolute-only form and wins when both are given.

row_height_twips

Integer. Row height in twips. NULL (default) inherits the document's row height (its rtf_style(), else the rtfreporter.row_height_twips option), else the height the band's font size implies. A value that is not one non-negative integer is an error.

font_size_half_points

Font size for this band, in half-points. NULL (default) inherits the document size. Setting it also recomputes the row height from that size unless row_height_twips is given.

font

Font family for this band, e.g. "Arial". NULL (default) uses the document font. A family not already in the document's font_table is added to it automatically, the way a colour is. A named vector gives one family per script slot (latin, east_asian, complex, optional hansi), e.g. c(latin = "Times New Roman", east_asian = "MS Mincho"); see rtf_document().

markup

Cell-text markup for this band; NULL (default) inherits the document setting. See rtftable().

cell_padding_left_twips, cell_padding_right_twips

Integer cell padding on the left / right side of each header (or footer) cell, matching the content-table convention. NULL (default) inherits the document's rtf_style(), else the resource baseline (0). A value that is not one non-negative integer is an error.

cell_padding_top_twips, cell_padding_bottom_twips

Integer cell padding above / below the text of each header (or footer) cell, in twips, written into the cell definitions. NULL (default) inherits the document's rtf_style(), else the resource baseline (0); 0 writes nothing.

drop_empty_rows

Logical. TRUE: a row whose tokens of one's own (rtf_document(tokens = ), options(rtfreporter.tokens = )) are all empty when the file is written, and which says nothing else but blanks and brackets ("<{POPULATION}>"), is left out. One header can then serve every report of a study, a report with no value for a line going without it. FALSE (default): every row is written.

color

The band's text colour, a 6-digit hex string such as "#7F7F7F"; NULL (default) leaves the text in the document's colour (black). A row given as list(columns = , color = ) has its own. The colour is added to the document's colour table.

Value

A named list of the band's settings, one element per argument (rows, border, width_twips, width, row_height_twips, ...), for rtf_section()(header = , footer = ).

Examples

hdr <- rtf_header(
  rows = list(
    c(l = "Protocol: RTF-101", r = "ACME Pharma"),
    c(l = "Table 14.1.1",     r = "Page {AUTO_PAGE} of {AUTO_TOTAL_PAGES}")
  )
)
ftr <- rtf_footer(c(l = "Confidential"))
